label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: J.T. Poston Memorial Lead
items.text: J.T. Poston leads the Memorial Tournament presented by Workday at 12-under after 1 hole, with Ryan Gerard and Sam Burns tied at 8-under, and Wyndham Clark at 6-under.

items.headline: Hatton Wins LIV Golf Andalucia
items.text: Tyrrell Hatton birdied two late holes to win LIV Golf Andalucia by two shots over Jon Rahm, who remains atop the LIV points standings; Hatton’s second LIV title.

items.headline: Scheffler’s Eagle via Rule 16.1
items.text: Scottie Scheffler used a favorable free drop under Rule 16.1 at the Memorial’s par-5 7th to move off a sprinkler head, leading to an 8-foot eagle putt sunk.
